text:
maria_cs: Quick capture from Acme onboarding call — throwing this into the thread for product triage. Main asks: 1) per-route billing visibility (customer wants per-endpoint cost breakdown), 2) clearer rollout docs for Dedicated -> Private transition, 3) cheaper embeddings for search (they see high token spend). They flagged renewal risk if cost/visibility doesn't improve.
eli_product: Thanks Maria — can you paste the short verbatim asks? want to score by impact/effort. :nerd_face:
mara_cs: pasted notes below from call (edited for clarity):
- "We need per-route cost so engineers can blame the right teams"
- "Docs for Dedicated -> Private were sparse; we hit networking hoops"
- "Embeddings spend blew our pilot budget, any cheaper quantized model options?"

tom_eng: re: per-route billing — we already emit per-model+route tokens in trace logs but not surfaced in UI. UX work + small backend aggregation job. Ballpark 2-3 dev days + a short data job.
sara_pm: propose quick triage: 1) Visibility (low effort, high trust impact), 2) Docs (medium effort, medium impact), 3) Embedding cost (variable, depends on model/quantization). I can run an affinity map in the next sprint.
nate_data: I can run a quick usage slice to show how much embeddings contributed for Acme specifically and for top 10 customers. SQL snippet I'll run: ```SELECT customer_id, sum(embedding_tokens) as emb_tokens, sum(generation_tokens) as gen_tokens FROM billing.events WHERE date >= '2025-12-01' AND customer_id = 'acme' GROUP BY customer_id;```
eli_product: perfect — Nate, if you can push numbers by EOD tomorrow that helps prioritization. Also want a 1-pager for CS to share with customer about short-term mitigations (e.g., lowering embedding dims, caching).
maria_cs: I'll draft the 1-pager. Quick mitigation notes from call: enable prefix caching for search, recommend 1-shot embeddings with caching layer, offer a short-term discount on embedding units while we investigate.
tom_eng: for cheaper embeddings — research team has a 4-bit quantized candidate. Need perf/regression evals before recommending. Could be 2-3 sprints to validate.
sara_pm: Given renewal risk, propose immediate runway actions: (A) Visibility patch (1 sprint, priority high), (B) Customer-facing doc + CS 1-pager (2-3 days), (C) Embedding investigation (track, report by end of sprint). Agree? :+1:
eli_product: agree. I'll create a feature card and tag eng/docs. Card will include impact estimate and links.
cs_bot: Transcript saved: https://redwood-internal/notes/2155551111-acme-onboard, and assigned ticket #CS-4829.
maria_cs: thanks all — flagging for weekly triage. tagging @sara_pm @eli_product for next steps. :thumbsup:
